subject: Evidence request: no-training technical assurance & SLA/credits
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@noblehealth.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Evidence request: no-training technical assurance & SLA/credits

Hi Dylan / Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — NobleHealth is progressing toward a pilot but procurement and security need concrete operational evidence before we can sign the DPA addendum. Specifically they asked for: 

- An architecture diagram showing where customer interaction data is stored, whether KV/prefix caching is ephemeral, and the exact point(s) where data is excluded from any model-update pipelines.
- A sample, redacted audit log that demonstrates there are no training jobs consuming customer interaction logs (ideally a 30-day window).
- A signed list of subprocessors and the data flows that show no outbound transfers to third-party model trainers.
- Confirmation of KMS residency and whether customer keys can be locked to a US region for this account.
- A mapping document that ties the above to SOC2 controls (or equivalent) so our security team can short-circuit manual review.

Procurement is also asking whether Redwood would consider an SLA-backed timeline for delivering these artifacts and if there is any credit we can apply in the event evidence is late — they want this captured in an MOU that will be attached to the SOW.

Can you let me know what you can provide this week and what will require a 7–14 day ops lead time? 

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Director, Security & Procurement
NobleHealth Systems

--
Note: procurement prefers attachments as encrypted PDFs over SFTP links.

From: dylan_brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@noblehealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: no-training technical assurance & SLA/credits

Elena — thanks for the clear list.  We can provide a staggered evidence package and proposed SLA language. I've attached an evidence pack as a single PDF for procurement review (redwood_no_train_evidence_pack.pdf); it contains:

1) Architecture diagram (ephemeral KV and inference-only paths highlighted)
2) Ops runbook excerpt (how we guarantee no model-update ingestion for customer-tagged traffic)
3) Redacted audit-log sample (30 days) showing no training jobs referencing customer IDs
4) Subprocessor mapping + confirmation that model-training vendors are not in the customer data path
5) KMS residency confirmation and key-handle options (customer-managed HSM / Redwood KMS policy)
6) SOC2 control crosswalk (controls mapped to each artifact)

High-level timeline we can commit to: 
- Day 0 (today): deliver the evidence pack PDF for initial review (attached).
- Day 3–5: deliver expanded audit slices and ops walkthrough recording if your security team wants to schedule.
- Day 7–14: provide full subprocessor attestation and optional onshore-provenance export (SFTP) if required.

SLA/credits: we typically reserve SLA credit conversations for legal, but from an ops standpoint we're comfortable proposing a 7 business day delivery SLO for the complete attestation with a credit mechanism for missed deadlines. Kimberly — can you confirm if Product/Legal are OK with a 5–10% credit cap for this class of deliverable?

Next steps: preferred time for a technical call with your security team? I can do 11/30 2pm PT or 12/1 morning. Also tagging Neha for the subprocessor mapping details and any encryption/export knobs.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_no_train_evidence_pack.pdf (3 pages, redacted diagrams + logs)

From: Alex Cho <alex.cho@procure.noblehealth.com>
To: dylan_brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Elena Torres <elena@noblehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 13:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: no-training technical assurance & SLA/credits

Dylan / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the PDF. Procurement reviewed the pack and we circulated a short MOU that captures delivery expectations and credit language; I've attached the signed MOU we will include with the SOW (signed-mou.pdf). Procurement's asks in brief: 

- MOU to state a 7 business day delivery window for the complete attestation package.
- If Redwood misses the delivery window, a single credit of 5% of the month one bill (applies once per SOW) — that's our initial ask.

If you can confirm acceptance of the MOU text today, legal will stitch it into the SOW and we can proceed to signatures.

Thanks,
Alex Cho
Sr. Procurement Manager
NobleHealth Systems

From: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Cho <alex.cho@procure.noblehealth.com>, Elena Torres <elena@noblehealth.com>, dylan_brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 15:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: no-training technical assurance & SLA/credits

Alex / Elena — appreciate the clarity. We reviewed the MOU and the attached evidence pack. Redwood is willing to accept the proposed MOU language with the following operational guardrails and a small amendment: 

- Acceptance: Redwood accepts the 7 business day delivery window and the one-time 5% month-one credit as stated, contingent on delivery scope matching the attached evidence pack (redwood_no_train_evidence_pack.pdf) and the sse-matrix.xlsx that I'm attaching now.
- Guardrail: If NobleHealth requests additional artifacts beyond the pack (for example, raw logs or on-premise scans), we will log those as separate evidence requests that may carry a different timeline; we will not treat those as missed-deliverable credits under this MOU.
- Ops plan: propose a short "canary" handoff — we will deliver the full pack to your security team within 3 business days for an initial review; if any clarifications are needed, we will provide the supplemental artifacts by day 7.

Legal: please confirm whether the MOU can be attached to the SOW as an exhibit. If you want, we can run the exact MOU text past Legal this afternoon and confirm sign-off tonight.

Neha — please prepare the subprocessor attestation and the KMS residency confirmation (I noted the customer prefers US-bound keys).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Contracts & Compliance | Redwood Inference

Attachments: sse-matrix.xlsx (Operational mapping to controls)
